title: Wattson: IoT Power Side-Channel Intrusion Detection
description: Analysis and training code for a low-cost power side-channel intrusion detection system for IoT devices (Raspberry Pi 3B, ACS712/MCP3008 sensor). Detects DoS, port-scan, and SSH brute-force attacks from AC power draw. Results are compared against Lightbody et al.'s prior work, which relied on a laboratory-grade power analyzer.
